kevin: Originate RC rc-dryrun-202504 at artifact sha:9f8e7d6c. This one is a conservative change (timeout tuning) but we want a dry-run rollback to validate playbooks during the quiet window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Seeking quick ack and a sheriff.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-dryrun-202504 build green. Tests passed. Release notes draft: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-dryrun-202504

maya: No DB changes? Are feature flags scoped?

kevin: No DB work. Flags scoped to routing tag 'timeout-test'. snippet: `runtime.timeout_ms = { scope: "timeout-test" }`.

sheriff: I'll take quiet window. Provide commit and rollback artifact and the dry-run plan.

kevin: commit sha: 9f8e7d6c. rollback artifact: sha:00aa11bb. Dry-run plan: after canary -> run simulated rollback (no traffic flip) using `deploy simulate-rollback --rc=rc-dryrun-202504` to exercise runbook hooks and ticketing. Real rollback command kept in playbook. Runbook: /runbooks/rc-dryrun-playbook.md

ci-bot: Preflight checks: canary harness ready, synthetic probes loaded, simulated rollback tool present and has permissions.

maya: QA: run smoke on staging; p99 +2% baseline. QA +1 for canary. Request canary stages: 1% 10m, 10% 15m, full. Watch synthetic-error-injection monitors.

sheriff: Abort thresholds: error rate >1% or p99 +50% for 10m. Deadman 30m. I'll watch dashboards.

kevin: kicking promotion. @deploy-bot promote please.

deploy-bot: ACTION by kevin: scheduled promotion at 01:12 UTC. Canary: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Health probes: /health and synthetic-assert.

deploy-bot: Stage 1: 1% canary deployed. Health passing.

maya: smoke ok on canary.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: 10% traffic. Health passing.

kevin: running simulated rollback now to validate alerts and ticketing (no traffic change). Command run: `deploy simulate-rollback --rc=rc-dryrun-202504 --dry-run`

ci-bot: Simulated rollback executed: runbook hooks triggered, alerting path validated, rollback ticket template generated (ticket: RB-9123). No impact to live traffic.

sheriff: Confirmed alerts fired to oncall contact and ticket created. Dry-run successful.

kevin: proceeding to full promote.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across regions.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions running rc-dryrun-202504 sha:9f8e7d6c. Post-deploy checks green.

maya: starting extended evals (30m). small 0.1% drift in a niche rerank cohort; filing EV-1234. Not blocking.

sheriff: marking rollout stable. Deadman canceled.

kevin: final steps: pin artifact to rc/dryrun/202504 and add note about dry-run validation to release notes. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Reminder rollback command if needed: `deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:00aa11bb --reason="regression EV-1234"`
